_comment: Phase 11 plan 02 (TEST-01): committed N=3 rig TEMPLATE for run_test4.ps1 - copy to local.rig.n3.json (gitignored, like the N=4 local.rig.json) and adjust installDir/save/seconds per the scenario being run. Mirrors local.rig.json's real dev-machine layout (Clone4 as host; Clone1 + Clone2 as joins) with only 3 instances declared. Pass -ExpectedInstances 3 to run_test4.ps1 and -ExpectedInstances 3 (or rely on run_meta.json's instanceCount) to analyze_run4.ps1/analyze_wnpc_diff4.ps1 for the offline judge.
_save_comment: wanderer4 = the same baked 4-squad start the N=4 gates use (tools/MultiplayerStartGen). At N=3 only ranks 0/1/2 are ever connected; rank 3 stays idle baked furniture for the whole run (research Risk 2, budgeted for live verification in Plan 03) - do not assume it needs a different save.
_seconds_comment: 320 matches ScenarioSaveLoad.cpp's HOST_DURATION_MS/1000 - the longest of the three locked N=2/N=3 gates (milestone_a_gate/player_state_gate finish sooner); lower this to match scenarios.psd1's entry for a shorter gate.

instances._comment: join1 is the ESTABLISHED join - one of Leg R's two contestants (rank 1) alongside join2 below (rank 2). No lifecycle lever needed.

join2 mirrors local.rig.json's join3: the deliberately deferred/late-launching instance (reconnectAtSec, same lever save_load_gate's N=4 rig uses). ScenarioSaveLoad.cpp's identity fix (KENSHICOOP_SCENARIO_JOIN_DURATION_SEC, not a rank comparison) resolves join2 as the late-joiner regardless of its rank number. Once connected, join2 (rank 2) ALSO becomes one of Leg R's two contestants alongside join1 (rank 1) - RankRoster's lowestTwoJoins() naturally resolves to (1,2) at N=3, matching the locked decision ('the two lowest join ranks (=1,2 at N>=3)'). Set to null for a plain N=3 connect with no deferred-launch lever (milestone_a_gate/player_state_gate do not need it).
